contribution.value: A comprehensive evaluation of four PTQ methods (GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, FP8) on 12 instruction-tuned LLMs spanning 1B to 405B parameters across 13 datasets, finding FP8 is most robust, AWQ outperforms GPTQ, smaller models suffer severe drops at 4-bit, and quantization magnifies inherent model weaknesses rather than correlating with task difficulty.
